card.text: The Crab combines an expanding supernova remnant with a pulsar wind nebula. It lies about 2,000 parsecs away.

sources.label: Martin, Milisavljevic & Drissen (2021), 3D mapping of the Crab Nebula with SITELLE. I

hubble-optical.title: Crab ejecta in optical emission lines
hubble-optical.summary: Optical line colors on expansion-inferred ejecta and a modeled pulsar wind; fine structure is softened.

webb-infrared.title: Crab filaments and pulsar wind in infrared
webb-infrared.summary: Infrared false color on expansion-inferred ejecta and a modeled pulsar wind; fine structure is softened.

webb-components.title: Crab dust, sulfur and synchrotron component color
webb-components.summary: Published dust, sulfur and synchrotron component colors on an inferred 3D model; not measured material density.

spitzer-infrared.title: Crab mid-infrared emission at 24 micrometres
spitzer-infrared.summary: Mid-infrared false color on inferred ejecta and pulsar-wind geometry; brightness is not calibrated.

vla-radio.title: Crab radio synchrotron emission
vla-radio.summary: Radio display colors on modeled wind and ejecta geometry; no measured radio depth.

chandra-xray.title: Crab inner pulsar wind in X-rays
chandra-xray.summary: X-ray pulsar-wind display on published torus/jet assumptions; depth and emission strength are modeled.
